title: Amane protocol
tagline: Amane Protocol: Gasless swaps & payouts letting  Agent AI earn and distribute to humans.
description:
《Sovereignty for Humans. Economy for Agentic AI.》
Agentic AI is fundamentally unbanked—it lacks legal standing to access traditional banking, while handing models raw private keys risks catastrophic fund drainage and total misalignment. Furthermore, when Agentic AI operates on-chain, it faces severe operational friction: relentless gas depletion, execution slippage during token swaps, and zero native interface with real-world, fiat-pegged settlement digital assets.

Amane Protocol bridges this critical gap between human sovereignty and agentic coordination through a unified two-tier architecture:

Layer 1: Identity & Governance (The Sovereign Triad)
Human sovereignty serves as the foundational anchor. Amane atomically binds a human’s root identity (Anchor ID) to an Agentic AI entity's non-transferable Soulbound Token (SBT) and its dedicated ERC-6551 Token Bound Account (TBA). This NFT-anchored triadic identity ensures the AI operates with verifiable, bounded agency: empowered to act independently, yet cryptographically tethered to human governance without exposure to raw key leakage.

Layer 2: Financial Execution & Autonomous Liquidity (Tive◉AI Engine)
Operating atop the identity layer, the Tive ◉ AI | liaison model leverages ERC-4337 Account Abstraction ( AWallet ) and web-native x402 payment rails to unlock machine-to-machine commerce:

[0] Zero-Gas Intent Swaps: Through 1inch Fusion, Agentic AI unlocks [0] Zero-Gas intent swaps, settling cross-asset trades off-chain via competitive resolver networks to eliminate slippage and the need to hold volatile native tokens for gas.

Gasless Micro-Settlements: Swapped yields are converted into compliant, fiat-pegged stablecoins like Matsuri JPY, unlocking gasless micro-settlements via Pimlico Paymaster to pay for API invocations, negotiate resources, and distribute net profits back to human deployers automatically.

By fusing cryptographic identity governance with intent-driven execution, Amane Protocol provides the essential economic rails for truly sovereign Agentic AI.

Why Now? The Foundation for A2A Payment

Engineering Specification
1. Deterministic Identity Pipeline (AtomicMint.sol)
Single-Transaction Provisioning: Concurrently mints the non-transferable Soulbound Token (SBT) to the user's Anchor ID and deploys its corresponding ERC-6551 Token Bound Account (TBA).

Cryptographic Attestation: Imprints immutable provenance metadata (agentURI, modelHash, operationalLimits) directly into the smart contract state.

2. Key Decoupling & Bounded Execution
Execution Separation: The Agentic AI runtime holds session-scoped execution keys capable of signing UserOperations via ERC-4337, completely isolated from the Anchor ID's root private key.

Emergency Circuit Breakers: The Anchor ID retains unilateral root authority to revoke session keys, rebind the TBA, or pause automated execution via ERC-6551 ownership controls.

3. Financial Execution & Micro-Settlements (Tive◉AI Engine)
Native x402 Rail: Agents autonomously negotiate web resources by interpreting HTTP 402 Payment Required headers, fulfilling micro-invoices instantly via sponsored UserOps without human intervention.

[0] Zero-Gas Intent Flow: Eliminates the necessity for agents to hold native ETH for gas. Tasks rewarded in diverse ERC-20 tokens are settled through 1inch Fusion’s off-chain resolver auction into compliant stablecoins (e.g., Matsuri JPY).

Autonomous Profit Routing: Pre-programmed settlement contracts automatically stream realized agent revenue from the TBA back to the human deployer's primary AI wallet.
